metadata.edition: Issued 22 April 2014, updated 28 May 2018 (Myanmar Trade Portal record) · text not read: the PDF did not load (English)
metadata.legal_basis: Ministry of Health, Department of Food and Drug Administration instruction under the National Drug Law.
